response.sql: WITH order_counts AS (SELECT o.account_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS number_of_orders FROM `order` AS o JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3), overall_differences AS (SELECT account_id, region, number_of_orders, number_of_orders - AVG(number_of_orders) OVER () AS difference_from_overall_average FROM order_counts), regional_differences AS (SELECT account_id, region, number_of_orders, difference_from_overall_average, AVG(difference_from_overall_average) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS region_average_difference FROM overall_differences) SELECT account_id, region, number_of_orders, difference_from_overall_average, difference_from_overall_average - region_average_difference AS excess_over_region_average_difference FROM regional_differences WHERE difference_from_overall_average > region_average_difference ORDER BY excess_over_region_average_difference DESC LIMIT 10;
